# Budget Canada

> Budget Canada's car rental platform offering vehicle rentals across Canada and worldwide locations including Australia, South America, Caribbean, and Asia Pacific regions.

Budget.ca serves as the Canadian portal for Budget Car Rental, providing access to rental locations globally with a strong presence in Australia (Queensland, Victoria, NSW, Western Australia), Argentina, and other international markets. The site features vehicle catalogs, location finders, and booking tools for Canadian travelers.

## Key Topics

- Budget Car Rental
- Car rental locations
- Australia rentals
- Queensland locations
- Victoria locations
- NSW locations
- Western Australia
- Argentina car rental
- South America locations
- Caribbean rentals
- Asia Pacific region
- Vehicle fleet catalog
- Location finder
- Rental booking
- International car hire

## Vehicle Information

- [Budget Canada Rental Car Guides: All Available Vehicles](https://www.budget.ca/en/cars/vehicles/ca): Vehicle catalog showcasing Budget Canada's rental fleet and car classes

## International Location Directories

- [Budget Car Rental Argentina Locations](https://www.budget.ca/en/locations/ar): Argentina location directory with 48 rental offices across 31 cities
- [Budget Car Rental Aruba Locations](https://www.budget.ca/en/locations/ab): Aruba location directory with 5 rental offices in 3 cities
- [Budget Car Rental Angola Locations](https://www.budget.ca/en/locations/ao): Angola location directory with 5 rental offices in Luanda
- [Budget Car Rental Curacao Locations](https://www.budget.ca/en/locations/an): Curacao location directory with 6 rental offices in Willemstad
